[h2]Pros:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Straight forward controls
[*] Unique characters
[*] Brutal RNG
[*] Fun the play with friends
[*] Banger soundtrack
[*] Fantastic pixel graphics
[/list]

[h2]Cons:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some characters feel glossed over
[*] Some abilities feel not fully fleshed out at times
[*] Brutal RNG
[*] Too many loops feel too punishing at times
[/list]

[h2]Intro[/h2]

I didn't 100% the original Risk of Rain (got to 93%), and Steam hasn't even fully logged all of the play hours (208.8 hours) due to me playing with mods like Starstorm. I can definitely say from experience that this is a definite upgrade from the original. Much of the gameplay is th$
I can't wish enough luck to the guys at Hopoo and their future endeavors.
To Gearbox, you will 100% take the Hopoo gang for granted, and that frustrates me beyond belief. I would hope at the very least you take notes from them and give them the respect they deserve. If I find out you haven't, then I'll just add that to the list of reason I find Gearbox...[i]disappointing[/i], to say the least.

[h2]Review[/h2]

If you liked Risk of Rain 2, you might not like this game. Both OG and Returns are much more difficult, as you have one less axis of movement to dodge enemies. That's not to say RoR2 is bad (although Gearbox has certain made a few hiccups in recent past to make it not as enjoyable), but it's a different experience.

Artificer is probably one of the more if not the most disappointing thing about this game. In RoR2 she was quite a bit of fun to play, albeit overpowered at times, but her primary and utility abilities are extremely lackluster. OG RoR had a mod for Artificer that was better.

The other thing is some alternate abilities need a lot more getting used to or just make it to where you need more specific items to feel useful with the rest of the characters kit.  [spoiler]Bandit's alt primary and Enforcer's alt ult/special come to mind.[/spoiler]

Other than that, this is a great remake of the OG game.
Very Different than RoR 2. Much Much harder, but at the same time a unique experience if you are a fan of the franchise.
